notes: ὅς and ἄν are joined as one aligned unit for Whosoever under rule 50's single-word test.
ὅτι is unrepresented, the ASV punctuating the clause as direct speech (rule 43).
The substantival ἀπολελυμένην carries the whole her when she is put away clause, its supplied antecedent, subordinator, subject and copula riding inside the unit (rules 15, 74).
